entries.title: Review reading exceptions more clearly
entries.description: See why each reading was flagged, preview its meter photo, and compare the extracted value and confidence before resolving it.

entries.title: Manage the rate card
entries.description: Create, edit, activate, deactivate, and reorder time- or measure-based rates and their measure types.

entries.title: Review only relevant audit activity
entries.description: The Audit Log is now separated by business, so administrators see the appropriate activity in each workspace.

entries.title: Run jobs from the field
entries.description: View assigned jobs, start and stop machines with arrival and departure readings, and add unplanned machines. Work is saved on the phone and syncs when a connection is available.

entries.title: Keep reading captures safe
entries.description: Reading submissions now remain queued after temporary failures, while captures that cannot sync move to Needs attention with a clear reason.

entries.title: Check your app version
entries.description: Open the profile menu to see the installed app version.
